basic_profile.bio: An avid reader and amateur book collector from Portland, Oregon, who recently started to organize a personal library. Works as a freelance graphic designer and spends free time exploring new technologies and keeping up with crypto trends. Enjoys visiting local bookstores and has a growing interest in cataloging and digital libraries. Typically online during late evenings. Currently in a relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a background in graphic design with a keen interest in technology. Self-taught in areas of crypto and digital libraries, primarily through online resources and community discussions. Not very familiar with Excel but learning through trial and error.
